mechanism: The recycler durably classifies only a typed incomplete-output receipt as recoverable. Episode code explicitly acknowledges it, adds one fixed concise-action message, and requests a new measured dispatch. The failed body is never exposed; failed and corrective usage share original caps.
verified: Default policy retains the historical fail-closed behavior.
Only incomplete-output moves the checkpoint to model-failed-recoverable.
Explicit acknowledgement returns the checkpoint to idle; other uncertain failures remain unreplayable.
One correction completes the fixture and retains the length-limited receipt.
Correction count is limited to zero or one and all model receipts remain in accounting.
claim_ceiling: Offline recoverable-output instrumentation validity only; no provider outcome or benchmark claim.
